title: Idempotent Payment Webhook Consumer
description: Create an idempotent consumer for Stripe webhook events preventing duplicate account balance credits.
derived_requirements: Verify webhook HMAC signature before parsing JSON
Record event_id in processed_events table with unique constraint
Return 200 OK immediately for duplicate event_id without re-crediting

required_behavior: Atomic insert into idempotency log and balance credit in same DB transaction
Constant-time HMAC comparison to prevent timing attacks
forbidden_behavior: Crediting user balance twice when webhook is retried

failure_taxonomy.description: Duplicate webhook replay results in multiple wallet credits.

ground_truth_rationale: Payment consumers must guarantee exact-once semantic processing in distributed messaging environments.
